name: Katta Jewelers Promenade
description: Jewelers Promenade is the luxury‑craft district of Katta Castellum. Gemcutters, metalshapers, and arcane lapidaries work in terraced studios regulated by civic guilds. The district produces ceremonial regalia for Senate officials, arcane‑infused jewelry for casters, and fine ornaments for Katta’s elite.
